verdict.rationale: BigQuery's documented sandbox lets users try BigQuery without a credit card or billing account, at no cost, which is self-serve with no sales call. The free tier adds 10 GiB of storage and 1 TiB of queries per month, so analysts can run real queries on real data. missing for 10: specifics on which capabilities the sandbox limits (docs only say 'limited BigQuery capabilities'), independent or hands-on corroboration of the no-card sandbox experience.
